Uses and Administration Propofol is a short-acting anaesthetic given intrave- nously for the induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia (p.1780). It is also used for sedation (p.956) in adult patients undergoing diagnostic proce- dures, in those undergoing surgery with local or re- gional anaesthesia, and in ventilated adult patients un- der intensive care.
